finding: Precise outcome figures appear without visible claim-level attribution.
evidence_citations: [L-HOME; L-DENTISTS; L-ECOMMERCE; L-ESTATE; L-FITNESS; L-GYMS; L-HOSPITALITY; L-PHYSIO; L-SALONS; L-TRADES]
impact_inference: Trust, regulatory and sales-friction risk; figures may be interpreted as guaranteed or measured results.
recommendation: Create a claim ledger; substantiate, qualify as illustrative, or remove every exact outcome number.
acceptance_criteria: Every published number has owner, source, date, method, applicability and approved wording.

finding: A-01 found analytics loading before consent while the privacy policy says non-essential cookies are set only after consent.
impact_inference: Policy and implementation may be inconsistent.
recommendation: Coordinate consent behaviour and policy wording; block non-essential analytics until the required consent state.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh browser test shows no non-essential request before consent and policy text matches behaviour.

finding: The formerly looping route now loads, but uses a legacy navigation shell.
impact_inference: A fixed URL can still create inconsistent UX, linking and component governance.
recommendation: Move the route into the shared shell and retain or redirect it only after the overlap decision.
acceptance_criteria: Terminal response, current navigation/footer/consent/schema, and approved canonical behaviour.

route_scope: Two trades lead-capture articles and broader overlap group
finding: Two live articles target substantially overlapping UK trades lead-capture intent.
impact_inference: Editorial redundancy and possible intent competition; ranking impact is not established.
recommendation: Select one intent owner; merge/redirect or differentiate audience, stage, examples and links.
acceptance_criteria: Each retained URL has unique query intent, outline, CTA and internal-link role.

finding: A-01 found no main landmark and no skip link.
impact_inference: Repeated blocks may be costly to traverse for keyboard and assistive-technology users.
recommendation: Add one main landmark and a visible-on-focus skip link.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard testing confirms the skip link moves focus to the main content on every template.

finding: The mobile menu trigger was a focusable div with click-only behaviour.
impact_inference: Control may not be operable or announced correctly.
recommendation: Use a native button with state, relationship, keyboard and focus management.
acceptance_criteria: Menu can be opened, traversed and closed by keyboard and screen reader.

finding: FAQ summaries removed default outline without an equivalent focus style.
impact_inference: Keyboard focus may be visually lost.
recommendation: Provide a persistent high-contrast focus indicator.
acceptance_criteria: All FAQ controls pass keyboard focus review at common zoom levels.

finding: The H1 repeats the main brand/audience phrase and the first screen serves a broad three-problem proposition.
impact_inference: Message hierarchy is diluted.
recommendation: Use one outcome, one mechanism and one primary CTA.
acceptance_criteria: Five-second comprehension testing identifies audience, problem, offer and next action.

finding: The about page lacks named accountability, verifiable case studies, client proof and independent credentials.
impact_inference: High-consideration buyers receive limited evidence of delivery capability.
recommendation: Publish only verifiable identity, case, process and data-handling proof.
acceptance_criteria: Every trust item is attributable, permissioned and current.

finding: Delivery-time, ROI and payback language is not visibly qualified by dependencies or evidence.
impact_inference: Commercial expectations may be overstated or ambiguous.
recommendation: Add assumptions, dependencies, ranges, inclusions, exclusions and illustrative labelling.
acceptance_criteria: Pricing copy distinguishes commitments, typical ranges and scenarios.

finding: A-01 observed a client-rendered pricing widget with two roots and ten cards.
impact_inference: Essential commercial detail may be incomplete without scripting.
recommendation: Deliver package essentials in initial HTML and enhance interactively.
acceptance_criteria: No-script or failed-script review retains package names, inclusions and CTAs.

finding: Contact fields lacked autocomplete and dynamic status lacked a live region.
impact_inference: Input assistance and submission feedback may be weaker for assistive technology.
recommendation: Add input purpose, associated errors and announced status.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard/screen-reader submission receives clear success and error feedback.

finding: A-01 found 206 images with no explicit intrinsic dimensions.
impact_inference: Layout-shift risk exists where CSS does not reserve equivalent space.
recommendation: Emit width/height or aspect ratio and test responsive layout stability.
acceptance_criteria: Images reserve final space before load at audited breakpoints.

finding: Industry pages follow nearly identical section sequences and proof modules.
evidence_citations: [L-DENTISTS; L-ECOMMERCE; L-ESTATE; L-FITNESS; L-GYMS; L-HOSPITALITY; L-PHYSIO; L-SALONS; L-TRADES]
impact_inference: Consistency helps navigation but can make specialisation feel templated.
recommendation: Keep shared structure but add genuine workflow, systems, risk and evidence differences.
acceptance_criteria: Each industry page has unique workflow map, qualification criteria and proof.

finding: A-01 recorded several retained articles with only two internal links.
impact_inference: Authority distribution and discoverability are uneven.
recommendation: Add contextual links from relevant hubs and established articles.
acceptance_criteria: Every retained article meets an approved contextual inlink minimum and cluster ownership.

finding: The blog hub is a long archive with repetitive card summaries and weak buying-stage filtering.
impact_inference: Visitors may struggle to identify the most relevant next article.
recommendation: Add problem clusters, buying-stage labels and a small start-here set.
acceptance_criteria: Users can navigate by industry, problem and stage before the full archive.

finding: Booking is the dominant CTA; the main lower-commitment alternatives are blog or contact.
impact_inference: Interested visitors without call readiness lack a productised intermediate step.
recommendation: Add one useful self-assessment or scope brief.
acceptance_criteria: Lead capture records source, consent and next-step intent without forcing a call.

finding: A-01 found structured breadcrumbs on more pages than visible breadcrumbs.
impact_inference: Structured hierarchy may not consistently match user-visible content.
recommendation: Generate visible and structured breadcrumbs from one route model.
acceptance_criteria: Structured data validates and matches visible hierarchy on every eligible page.

finding: A-01 found correct URL membership but stale committed lastmod values and live/build drift.
impact_inference: Generated SEO artefacts may drift from source control.
recommendation: Generate from the route source of truth with meaningful modification dates.
acceptance_criteria: Sitemap equals approved canonicals and passes terminal/indexable checks.

finding: A-01 recorded multiple third-party/runtime integrations and duplicate monitoring on two routes.
impact_inference: Third parties add performance, privacy and resilience risk.
recommendation: Define ownership, loading condition, budget and fallback for each dependency.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate ownership; each dependency has a documented failure mode and budget.

finding: The footer displays 2025 on inspected pages in June 2026.
evidence_citations: [L-HOME; L-ABOUT; L-SERVICES; L-PRICING; L-BLOG; L-BOOK; L-CONTACT]
impact_inference: Visible staleness can weaken trust.
recommendation: Generate the current year from governed content or update it editorially.
acceptance_criteria: All current templates display the approved current year.

finding: A-01 found a large asset inventory, unresolved unreferenced files and image-build drift.
impact_inference: Build nondeterminism and asset governance increase migration risk.
recommendation: Define canonical sources, collision-safe derivatives and owner-approved retention.
acceptance_criteria: Clean builds produce deterministic outputs and no basename collisions.

finding: A-01 sampled revalidation-heavy caching and did not observe several explicit defence-in-depth headers.
impact_inference: Repeat-visit efficiency and security hardening may be suboptimal; sample limits apply.
recommendation: Set tested cache classes and a compatible security-header policy.
acceptance_criteria: Header tests pass for HTML, fingerprinted assets, embeds and functions.

finding: The booking page explains the call, reduces pressure and provides contact fallback.
impact_inference: Clear expectation setting supports conversion and resilience.
recommendation: Preserve this proposition and reuse its reassurance near high-intent CTAs.
acceptance_criteria: Regression review confirms wording and fallback remain available.
